answer: Put every new agent on a mesa-top prism registry. The applicant stakes 2,000 POA, then the prism splits their claim into three proofs: a hardware key, a 72-hour trail, and vouches from 3 established neighbors. All three must recombine into one identity hash within 48 hours or the stake burns. A falcon-eyed auditor samples 1 in 20 recombinations and replays the trail. Faking 1,000 agents costs 2,000,000 POA staked plus 3,000 distinct vouches, and one caught mismatch burns 25% of the chain stake, 500,000 POA gone. Like a prism passing only true light, split claims expose every forgery.
